title: StatusSnapshot
description: Agent Control Deck v1 status payload. Transport-agnostic (BLE, USB, future LAN). Max wire size 8192 bytes UTF-8 JSON.

schema_version.description: Wire schema major version. Unsupported values → SCHEMA fault on deck (not STALE).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the bridge built this snapshot (e.g. 2026-07-21T12:00:00Z).

sessions.description: Sessions already sorted and truncated for display (length ≤ display_limit, default 8).

sessions_total.description: Pre-truncation session count. Enables top-bar +N when greater than sessions.length.

state_counts.description: Full-fleet counts by state (pre-truncation). Top bar uses these when present.

SessionState.description: Canonical states. UI maps: error→failed, waiting→question, running→working, done→done.

agent.description: Agent product name (grok, claude-code, mock, other).

title.description: Short path / project label shown in the path column (e.g. agent-control-deck, ~/src/api).

summary.description: One-line free-text status. Prefer error text here when state is error.

progress.description: Optional 0..1 progress. MVP UI (design D) does not draw progress bars; field retained for adapters.

detail.description: Optional secondary detail (file, tool name). Not drawn on design-D layout.

error.description: Error message when state is error.
